approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.stableFeatures: Medium-brown complexion, dark natural curls around ears/nape, full dark beard, prominent straight/angular nose, lean adult build. Beige tunic and blue mantle recur but clothing is not identity.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.age: Adult, visually around thirty; Matthew does not fix an exact age. Ministry scenes span a few years, not decades.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.result: Compatible through retained Matthew scenes and current-main Mark 1 baptism. No new portrait generated.

approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.stableFeatures: Young adult woman, medium-brown complexion, dark tight/wavy curls at forehead, oval face, slender build, pale head covering.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.age: Young adult; exact age unspecified. Birth and flight scenes near in narrative time.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.result: Retained pair compatible; no new portrait generated.

approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.stableFeatures: Adult man with dark natural curls, dark beard, strong nose, medium-brown skin, lean build.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.age: Adult, exact age unspecified; no unsupported large aging between scenes.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.result: Retained pair compatible. Not Joseph son of Jacob or Joseph of Arimathea.

approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.stableFeatures: Swaddled young child with dark hair and brown complexion; face small and partly obscured.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.age: Infant/young child; Matthew calls him a young child and does not fix exact age.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.result: Limited detail compatible; no precise portrait anchor certified from tiny face. Not compared with Joseph as the same adult.

approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.stableFeatures: Medium-brown skin, full dark/gray beard, dense longer dark curls, robust lean adult build, coarse hair garment.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.age: Adult, visually thirties or forties; same baptism event in Mark does not justify aging.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.result: Current-main Matthew/Mark baptism pair compatible; Matthew 11 foreground figures are messengers, not John. No new portrait generated.

approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.stableFeatures: Varied brown complexions, natural dark curls, adult bearded men with varied builds, simple woven garments. Some recurring brown/cream headbands.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.age: Adults, mostly young to middle adult. No broad aging across ministry.
approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.result: Retained group compatible; occluded/off-frame men are not counted as absent. Exact name-to-face assignment is not secure and is not invented.

approvedMatthewReferenceInventory.stableFeatures: Earlier Moses: older medium-brown man, gray curls, full white/gray beard, weathered face. Earlier Elijah: lean medium-brown man, angular nose, gray-black natural curls/beard. See prior Numbers/Deuteronomy and Kings audits.

observations.Jesus / John the Baptist: The actual Matthew baptism, disciple calling and Mark baptism inspected at native resolution. Brown complexion, natural dark curls, full beard, angular nose and lean adult Jesus compatible. John the Baptist has denser longer curls, beard and coarse garment. No aging added for parallel accounts. Clothing alone is not identity.
observations.Paul / Saul: Conversion shows seated brown-skinned dark-curled bearded adult beside older Ananias. First journey shows a brown-skinned balding dark-curled, bearded adult with older gray-curled companion. Time/lighting can differ; council speaker identity cannot be assigned securely from clothing. These are source candidates only, not newly certified portrait anchors.
observations.Barnabas / apostles: First journey and council have several adult men; no unambiguous cross-image face assignment supplied. No named face map invented.
observations.Stephen: Actual Story scene shows standing slim adult with brown skin, dark curls and beard before a seated council. No portrayal added in Galatians.
observations.Names: John the Baptist is not apostle John. Mary/Joseph names may refer to unrelated people. OT Saul is not Paul. Candidate inventory intentionally does not certify those name matches.
observations.Ages: Galatians recalls earlier journeys and a fourteen-year interval. No new portrait or group is generated, so no unsupported age assignment is needed.
observations.RejectedAnchor: Transfiguration v1 Moses/Elijah faces remain superseded and are not used.
